reasons.title: Automate pattern recognition
reasons.text: The Woodpecker method has you review the same tactics multiple times until the patterns become almost automatic: forks, pins, double attacks, sacrifices… The goal is to spot opportunities faster during games.

reasons.title: Improve your calculation speed
reasons.text: By repeating the same exercises regularly, you gradually move from conscious thinking to instant recognition. You then spend your thinking time on complex positions rather than on basic tactics.

reasons.title: Turn mistakes into positive reflexes
reasons.text: The Woodpecker principle is to replay the puzzles until you solve them quickly and correctly. A tactic you once missed gradually becomes a pattern your brain recognizes naturally. This is especially effective at reducing recurring tactical mistakes.

method: Each session starts over from the first puzzle in the set.
You work through the puzzles until the timer runs out, as fast as possible without mistakes.
When you get through it all, the set grows by 20 puzzles.
